name: Calendar

inputs.label: Google Calendar
inputs.description: Your Google calendars and their events, through Eva's Google login.
inputs.why: The widget shows your events of the next days, in the colour of each calendar. It only reads them, and it never sees your Google login.

inputs.label: Location
inputs.description: Your last location, from your phone.
inputs.why: The widget shows the forecast of each day next to your events. It sends your location to Open-Meteo, rounded to about one kilometre.

inputs.label: Temperature unit
inputs.why: The widget shows each temperature in this unit.

hosts.why: The widget gets the forecast from Open-Meteo, a free weather service. It sends your location, rounded to about one kilometre.
The widget gets the air quality of today from Open-Meteo. It sends your location, rounded to about one kilometre.

prompt: The Calendar widget on the home page shows the person's Google Calendar for the next days, with the forecast of each day.
